items.title: Louis Cottrell, Jr. Interview, 1961-08-25
items.q: Robichaux is one of the bands that I do remember him speaking of as an orchestra.

ctx.x: I know at one time a lot of the bands they say didn't even use drum.

Didn't use drum. He was the first one with the John Robichaux band. So he began using drum in the orchestras in New Orleans. It was mostly string ensemble with a few brass instruments of that type. And he was the first one to be used.
Well, I suppose in those days he used the overhead beater on his drums, wasn't he? The foot pedal?
